profile.name: Janak Sanjel
profile.title: Backend Software Engineer (Python/JAVA) · Project Delivery Lead
profile.summary: Full-stack developer and project manager with hands-on production experience delivering 10+ live backend systems at NIRC, primarily on Python/Django with ReactJS frontends. Owns REST API design, relational schema design, and deployment end-to-end, and has applied event-driven patterns in production. Currently building applied AWS and PostgreSQL skills alongside a MySQL-heavy background. Combines individual-contributor backend ownership with real project-management experience — sprint planning, client delivery, and mentoring junior engineers — and is looking to grow into larger-scale, cloud-native backend systems.

skillCategories.name: Databases
skills: MySQL — schema design, query optimisation, indexing

experience.description: Owning backend delivery and project leadership across a portfolio of live client systems.
highlights: Served as both Project Manager and Full Stack Developer across 10+ concurrent client projects — led requirement gathering, sprint planning, client communication, and end-to-end technical delivery.
Designed and delivered complete backend features for 10+ live production systems, owning database schema design, REST API contracts, and deployment.
Built and maintained Django REST Framework backends integrated with ReactJS frontends; reduced client feedback cycles by ~30% through direct client collaboration.
Designed and optimised MySQL relational schemas for complex domains: accounting ledgers, recruitment pipelines, gym subscriptions, training institute records, and government municipal data.
Applied event-driven patterns to decouple long-running workflows (notifications, report generation) from request/response cycles across client systems.
Managed project timelines and coordinated cross-functional delivery for the Accounting Software, Gym Management System, and Training Management System simultaneously.
Contributed backend modules to GWP Palika Software (Grails/Java), a government municipal platform live in real Nepali local government offices.
Led Rakmina (Django + Next.js), an international recruitment portal that facilitated 500+ job placements in Lithuania — architected the ATS backend and employer dashboard APIs.
Built and published a Flutter mobile application on the Google Play Store, managing the full lifecycle from development to release.
Mentored junior engineers on API design and Django best practices; led code reviews and technical planning sessions.
